dn22:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kurūsu viharati. Kammāssadhammaṃ nāma Kurūnaṃ nigamo.
dn22:1.7: Ekāyano ayaṃ bhikkhave maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā soka-pariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkha-domanassānaṃ atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
dn22:1.9: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ --
dn22:1.10: vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ --
dn22:1.11: citte cittānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ --
dn22:1.12: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ. 2.
dn22:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati?
dn22:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu arañña-gato vā rukkha-mūlagato vā suññāgāra-gato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
dn22:2.3: So sato va assasati, sato passasati.
dn22:2.4: Dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘Dīghaṃ assasāmīti' pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto ‘Dīghaṃ passasāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:2.5: Rassaṃ vā assasanto ‘Rassaṃ assasāmīti' pajānāti, rassaṃ vā passasanto ‘Rassaṃ passasāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:2.7: ‘Passambhayaṃ kāya-saṃkhāraṃ assasissāmīti' sikkhati, ‘passambhayaṃ kāya-saṃkhāraṃ passasissāmīti' sikkhati.
dn22:2.8: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave dakkho bhamakāro vā bhamakārantevāsī vā dīghaṃ vā añchanto ‘Dīghaṃ añchāmīti' pajānāti, rassaṃ vā añchanto ‘Rassaṃ añchāmīti ' pajānāti,
dn22:2.9: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘Dīghaṃ assasāmīti' pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto ‘Dīghaṃ passasāmīti' pajānāti, rassaṃ vā assasanto ‘Rassaṃ assasāmīti' pajānāti, rassaṃ vā passasanto ‘Rassaṃ passasāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:2.10: ‘Sabbakāya-paṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti ' sikkhati, ‘sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti' sikkati. ‘Passambhayaṃ kāya-saṃkhāraṃ assasissāmīti' sikkati, ‘passambhayaṃ kāya-saṃkhāraṃ passasissāmīti' sikkhati.
dn22:2.11: ‘Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
dn22:2.12: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati.
dn22:2.13: ‘Atthi kāyo' ti vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:2.14: Evam pi bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati. 3.
dn22:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu gacchanto vā ‘Gacchāmīti' pajānāti, ṭhito vā ‘Ṭhito 'mhīti' pajānāti, nisinno vā ‘Nisinno 'mhīti' pajānāti, sayāno vā ‘Sayāno 'mhīti' pajānāti.
dn22:3.2: Yathā yathā vā pan' assa kāyo paṇihito hoti, tathā tathā naṃ pajānāti.
dn22:3.3: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
dn22:3.4: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati.
dn22:3.5: ‘Atthi kāyo' ti vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:3.6: Evam pi bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati. 4.
dn22:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajāna-kārī hoti. Ālokite vilokite sampajāna-kārī hoti. Sammiñjite pasārite sampajāna-kārī hoti. Saṅghāṭi-patta-cīvara-dhāraṇe sampajāna-kārī hoti. Asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajāna-kārī hoti. Uccāra-passāvakamme sampajāna-kārī hoti. Gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhī-bhāve sampajāna-kārī hoti.
dn22:4.2: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati. Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya- dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati. ‘Atthi kāyo' ti vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:4.3: Evam pi bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati. 5.
dn22:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesa-matthakā taca-pariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati:
dn22:5.2: ‘Atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahārū aṭṭhī aṭṭhi-miñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ anta-guṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan ti.'
dn22:5.3: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave ubhato-mukhā mutoli pūrā nānā-vihitassa dhaññassa, seyyathīdaṃ sālīnaṃ vīhīnaṃ muggānaṃ māsānaṃ tilānaṃ taṇḍulānaṃ, tam enaṃ cakkhumā puriso muñcitvā paccavekkheyya: ‘Ime sālī, ime vīhī, ime muggā, ime māsā, ime tilā, ime taṇḍulā ti' --
dn22:5.4: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesa-matthakā taca-pariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati:
dn22:5.5: ‘Atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahārū aṭṭhī aṭṭhi-miñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ anta-guṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan ti.'
dn22:5.6: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati. Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati. ‘Atthi kāyo ti' vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:5.7: Evam pi bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati. 6.
dn22:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ yathā-ṭhitaṃ yathā-paṇihitaṃ dhātuso paccavekkhati:
dn22:6.2: ‘Atthi imasmiṃ kāye paṭhavī-dhātu āpo-dhātu tejo-dhātu vāyo-dhātūti.'
dn22:6.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā gāviṃ vadhitvā cātummahāpathe bilaso paṭivibhajitvā nisinno assa,
dn22:6.4: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ yathā- ṭhitaṃ yathā-paṇihitaṃ dhātuso paccavekkhati:
dn22:6.5: ‘Atthi imasmiṃ kāye paṭhavī-dhātu āpodhātu tejo-dhātu vāyo-dhātūti.'
dn22:6.6: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati. Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati. ‘Atthi kāyo ti' vā pan' assa sati paccuṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:6.7: Evam pi bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati. 7.
dn22:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu seyyathā pi passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ ekāhamataṃ vā dvīhamataṃ vā tīhamataṃ vā uddhumātakaṃ vinīlakaṃ vipubbaka-jātaṃ,
dn22:7.3: ‘Ayam pi kho kāyo evaṃ-dhammo evaṃ-bhāvī etaṃ anatīto ti.'
dn22:7.4: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati. Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati. ‘Atthi kāyo ti' vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:7.5: Evam pi bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati. 8.
dn22:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu seyyathā pi passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ supāṇehi vā khajjamānaṃ sigālehi vā khajjamānaṃ vividhehi vā pāṇaka-jātehi khajjamānaṃ,
dn22:8.3: ‘Ayam pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃ-bhāvī etaṃ anatīto ti.'
dn22:8.4: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati. Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati. ‘Atthi kāyo ti' vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:8.5: Evam pi bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati. 9.
dn22:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu seyyathā pi passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhi-saṅkhalikaṃ sa-maṃsa-lohitaṃ nahāru- sambandhaṃ , . . . pe . . .
dn22:9.4: aṭṭhikāni apagata-sambandhāni disā-vidisāsu vikkhittāni aññena hatthaṭṭhikaṃ aññena pādaṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅghaṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūraṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭaṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhi-kaṇṭakaṃ aññena sīsa-kaṭāhaṃ,
dn22:9.6: ‘Ayam pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃ-bhāvī etaṃ anatīto ti.'
dn22:9.7: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati. Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī kāyasmiṃ viharati. ‘Atthi kāyo' ti' vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati- mattāya . Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. Evam pi bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī
dn22:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu seyyathā pi passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkha-vaṇṇūpanibhāni, . . . pe . . .
dn22:10.5: ‘Ayam pi kho kāyo evaṃ-dhammo evaṃ-bhāvī etaṃ anatīto ti.'
dn22:10.6: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
dn22:10.7: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati.
dn22:10.8: ‘Atthi kāyo ti' vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādayati.
dn22:10.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati. 11.
dn22:11.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati?
dn22:11.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno ‘Sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti' pajānāti,
dn22:11.3: dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno ‘Dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:11.4: Adukkha-m-asukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno ‘ Adukkha-m-asukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:11.5: Sāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno ‘Sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:11.6: Nirāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno ‘Nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:11.7: Sāmisaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno ‘Sāmisaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyānīti' pajānāti.
dn22:11.8: Nirāmisaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno ‘Nirāmisaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:11.9: Sāmisaṃ vā adukkha-m-asukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno ‘Sāmisaṃ adukkha-m-asukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:11.10: Nirāmisaṃ vā adukkha-m-asukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno ‘Nirāmisaṃ adukkha-m-asukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti' pajānāti.
dn22:11.11: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati.
dn22:11.12: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā vedanāsu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā vedanāsu viharati, samudaya-vayadhammānupassī vā vedanāsu viharati.
dn22:11.13: ‘Atthi vedanā ti' vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñaṇamattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:11.14: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati. 12.
dn22:12.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu citte cittānupassī viharati?
dn22:12.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘sarāgaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.3: vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vītarāgaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.4: sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘sadosaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.5: vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vītadosaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.6: samohaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘samohaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.7: vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vītamohaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.8: saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘saṃkhittaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.9: vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vikkhittaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.10: mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ ‘mahaggataṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.11: amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ ‘amahaggataṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.12: sa-uttaraṃ vā cittaṃ ‘sa-uttaraṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.13: anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ ‘anuttaraṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.14: samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘samāhitaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.15: asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘asamāhitaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.16: vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vimuttaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti,
dn22:12.17: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘avimuttaṃ cittan ti' pajānāti.
dn22:12.18: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā citte cittānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā citte cittānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā citte cittānupassī viharati.
dn22:12.19: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā cittasmiṃ viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā cittasmiṃ viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā cittasmiṃ viharati.
dn22:12.20: ‘Atthi cittan ti' vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:12.21: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu citte cittānupassī viharati. 13.
dn22:13.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati?
dn22:13.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu.
dn22:13.3: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu?
dn22:13.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ ‘Atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando ti' pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ ‘N' atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando ti' pajānāti. Yathā ca anuppannassa kāmacchandassa uppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa kāmacchandassa pahānaṃ hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa kāmacchandassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti.
dn22:13.5: Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vyāpādaṃ ‘Atthi me ajjhattaṃ vyāpādo ti' pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vyāpādaṃ ‘N' atthi me ajjhattaṃ vyāpādo ti' pajānāti. Yathā ca anuppannassa vyāpādassa uppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa vyāpādassa pahānaṃ hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa vyāpādassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti.
dn22:13.6: Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ thīna-middhaṃ ‘Atthi me ajjhattaṃ thīna-middhan ti' pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ thīna-middham ‘N' atthi me ajjhattaṃ thīnamiddhan ti' pajānāti. Yathā ca anuppannassa thīnamiddhassa uppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa thīna-middhassa pahānaṃ hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa thīna-middhassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti.
dn22:13.7: Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ uddhacca-kukkuccaṃ ‘Atthi me ajjhattaṃ uddhacca-kukkuccan ti' pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ uddhacca-kukkuccaṃ ‘N' atthi me ajjhattaṃ uddhacca-kukkuccan ti' pajānāti. Yathā ca anuppannassa uddhacca-kukkuccassa uppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa uddhacca-kukkucassa pahānaṃ hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa uddhacca-kukkuccassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti.
dn22:13.8: Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vicikiccahaṃ ‘Atthi me ajjhattaṃ vicikicchā ti' pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vicikicchaṃ ‘N' atthi me ajjhattaṃ vicikicchā ti' pajānāti. Yathā ca anuppannāya vicikicchāya uppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannāya vicikicchāya pahānaṃ hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnāya vicikicchāya āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti.
dn22:13.9: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati.
dn22:13.10: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati.
dn22:13.11: ‘Atthi dhammā ti' vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇamattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:13.12: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu. 14.
dn22:14.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcas' upādānakkhandhesu.
dn22:14.2: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcas' upādānakkhandhesu?
dn22:14.4: ‘Iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthagamo --
dn22:14.5: iti vedanā, iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthagamo --
dn22:14.6: iti saññā, iti saññāya samudayo, iti saññāya atthagamo --
dn22:14.7: iti saṃkhārā, iti saṃkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṃkhārānaṃ atthagamo
dn22:14.8: -iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti,'
dn22:14.9: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhatta-bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati.
dn22:14.10: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati.
dn22:14.11: ‘Atthi dhammā ti' vā pan' assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇa-mattāya patissatimattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:14.12: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcas' upādānakkhandhesu. 15.
dn22:15.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati chasu ajjhattika-bāhiresu āyatanesu.
dn22:15.2: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati chasu ajjhattika-bāhiresu āyatanesu?
dn22:15.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhuñ ca pajānāti, rūpe ca pajānāti, yañ ca tad ubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṃyojanaṃ tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa saṃyojanassa uppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa saṃyojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa saṃyojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti . . .
dn22:15.4: sotañ ca pajānāti, sadde ca pajānāti . . . pe . . . ghānañ ca
dn22:15.5: pajānāti, gandhe ca pajānāti . . . pe . . . jivhañ ca
dn22:15.6: pajānāti, rase ca pajānāti . . . pe . . . kāyañ ca
dn22:15.7: pajānāti, phoṭṭhabbe ca pajānāti . . . pe . . . manañ ca
dn22:15.8: pajānāti, dhamme ca pajānāti, yañ ca tad ubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṃyojanaṃ tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa saṃyojanassa uppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa saṃyojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa saṃyojanassa āyatim anuppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti.
dn22:15.9: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati.
dn22:15.10: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati.

dn22:15.12: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ajjhattika-bāhiresu āyatanesu. 16.
dn22:16.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati sattasu bojjhaṅgesu.
dn22:16.2: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati sattasu bojjhaṅgesu?
dn22:16.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘Atthi me ajjhattaṃ sati-sambojjhaṅgo ti pajānāti. Asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ sati-sambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘N' atthi me ajjhattaṃ sati-sambojjhaṅgo ti' pajānāti. Yathā ca anuppannassa sati-sambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa sati-sambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañ ca pajānāti. . . .

Asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ upekhā-sambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘N' atthi me ajjhattaṃ upekhā-sambojjhaṅgo ti' pajānāti. Yathā ca anuppannassa upekhā-sambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañ ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa upekhā-sambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañ
dn22:16.10: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati.
dn22:16.11: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudaya-vaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati.
dn22:16.12: ‘Atthi dhammā ti' vā pan' assa sati paccuppaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇamattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:16.13: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati sattasu sambojjhaṅgesu. 17.
dn22:17.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati catusu ariya-saccesu.
dn22:17.2: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati catusu ariya-saccesu?
dn22:17.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘Idaṃ dukkhan ti' yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘Ayaṃ dukkha-samudayo ti' yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘Ayaṃ dukkha-nirodho ti' yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘Ayaṃ dukkha-nirodha-gāminī paṭipadā ti' yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. 18.
dn22:18.2: Jāti pi dukkhā, jarā pi dukkhā [vyādhi pi dukkhā], maraṇam pi dukkhaṃ, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanassupāyāsā pi dukkhā, yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ, saṃkhittena pañcupādāna-kkhandhā dukkhā.
dn22:18.4: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi satta-nikāye jāti sañjāti okkanti abhinibbatti khandānaṃ pātu-bhāvo āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho,
dn22:18.7: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi satta-nikāye jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko,
dn22:18.10: Yam tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā satta-nikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kāla-kiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷebarassa nikkhepo,
dn22:18.13: Yo kho bhikkhave aññataraññatarena vyasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkha-dhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ anto-soko anto-parisoko,
dn22:18.16: Yo kho bhikkhave aññataraññatarena vyasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkha-dhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo paridevo ādevanā paridevanā ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ,
dn22:18.19: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāya-samphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ,
dn22:18.22: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ manosamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ,
dn22:18.25: Yo kho bhikkhave aññataraññatarena vyasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkha-dhammena phuṭṭhassa āyāso upāyāso āyāsitattaṃ upāyāsitattaṃ,
dn22:18.33: yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ?
dn22:18.34: Jāti-dhammānaṃ bhikkhave sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati:
dn22:18.35: ‘Aho vata mayaṃ na jāti-dhammā assāma, na ca vata no jāti āgaccheyyāti.'
dn22:18.36: Na kho pan' etaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ.
dn22:18.37: Idam pi yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ.
dn22:18.40: sattānaṃ . . . pe . . . vyādhi-dhammānaṃ bhikkhave sattānaṃ . . . pe . . . maraṇa-dhammānaṃ bhikkhave sattānaṃ . . . pe . . . soka-parideva-dukkha-domanassupāyāsa-
dn22:18.41: dhammānaṃ bhikkhave sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati: ‘Aho vata mayaṃ na soka-parideva-dukkhadomanassa-upāyāsa-dhammā assāma, na ca vata no soka-parideva-dukkha-domanassa-upāyāsā āgaccheyyun ti.'
dn22:18.42: Na kho pan' etaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ. Idam pi yam p' icchaṃ na labhati
dn22:18.48: Katame ca bhikkhave saṃkhittena pañcupādāna-kkhandhā dukkhā?
dn22:18.49: Seyyathīdaṃ rūpūpādāna-kkhandho vedanūpādāna-kkhandho saññūpādāna-kkhandho saṃkhārūpādāna-kkhandho viññāṇūpādānakkhandho ,
dn22:18.50: ime vuccanti bhikkhave saṃkhittena pañcupādāna-kkhandhā dukkhā.
dn22:19.2: Yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandi-rāga-sahagatā tatra tatrābhinandinī, seyyathīdaṃ
dn22:19.4: Sā kho pan' esā bhikkhave taṇhā kattha uppajjamānā uppajjati, kattha nivisamānā nivisati?

dn22:19.7: Cakkhuṃ loke piya-rūpaṃ sāta-rūpaṃ, etth' esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.

dn22:21.2: Ayam eva Ariyo Aṭṭhaṅgiko Maggo, seyyathīdaṃ
dn22:21.3: sammā-diṭṭhi sammā-saṃkappo sammā-vācā sammākammanto sammā-ājīvo sammā-vāyāmo sammā-sati sammā-samādhi. 4
dn22:21.5: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave dukkhe ñāṇaṃ dukkha-samudaye ñāṇaṃ dukkha-nirodhe ñāṇaṃ dukkha-nirodha-gāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ,
dn22:21.11: Musā-vādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vecāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī,
dn22:21.14: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā verammaṇī, kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī,
dn22:21.17: Idha bhikkhave ariya-sāvako micchā-ājīvaṃ pahāya sammā-ājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti,
dn22:21.20: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati, viriyaṃ ārabhati, cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn22:21.21: Uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati, viriyaṃ ārabhati, cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn22:21.22: Anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati, viriyaṃ ārabhati, cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn22:21.23: Uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati, viriyaṃ ārabhati, cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn22:21.26: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ,
dn22:21.29: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ.
dn22:21.32: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn22:21.33: Vitakka-vicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodi-bhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn22:21.34: Pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: ‘upekhako satimā sukha-vihārī ti' tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn22:21.35: Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb' eva somanassa-domanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkha-m-asukhaṃ upekhā-sati-pārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn22:21.38: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati.
dn22:21.39: Samudaya-dhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudaya-vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati.
dn22:21.40: "Atthi dhammā ti" vā pan' assa sati paccuppaṭṭhitā hoti yāvad eva ñāṇamattāya patissati-mattāya. Anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:21.41: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati catusu ariyasaccesu. 22.
dn22:22.1: Yo hi koci bhikkhave ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya satta-vassāni, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ,
dn22:22.2: diṭṭhe va dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
dn22:22.4: yo hi koci bhikkhave ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya cha vassāni . . . pe . . .
dn22:22.9: ekaṃ vassaṃ, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, diṭṭhe va dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
dn22:22.11: yo hi koci bhikkhave ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya satta-māsāni, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā. Tiṭṭhantu bhikkhave sattamāsāni,
dn22:22.14: yo hi koci bhikkhu ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya cha-māsāni . . . pe . . .
dn22:22.20: aḍḍha-māsaṃ, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, diṭṭhe va dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
dn22:22.22: yo hi koci bhikkhave ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya sattāhaṃ, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ,
dn22:22.23: diṭṭhe va dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
dn22:22.24: ‘Ekāyano ayaṃ bhikkhave maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkha-domanassānaṃ atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yad idaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā ti'
dn22:22.25: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttan ti.
dn22:22.27: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti. MAHĀ-SATIPAṬṬHĀNA-
